name: @admitto/ui
description: Admitto design system — Tabler-flavoured tokens and React primitives

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp -R src/assets/. dist/assets/
scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @admitto/shared && npm run build -w @admitto/crypto && npm run build -w @admitto/db && npm run build -w @admitto/mail-templates && npm run build -w @admitto/tickets && npm run build -w @admitto/auth
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @admitto/shared && npm run build -w @admitto/crypto && npm run build -w @admitto/db && npm run build -w @admitto/mail-templates && npm run build -w @admitto/tickets && npm run build -w @admitto/auth
